title: CI diet: free the GitHub-hosted runner pool for research without weakening any check (data-only PRs run only the tests that read their paths)
note: [2026-10-13 lane CI-DIET] MEASURED over the 48h ending 20:18Z (9,500 runs from the Actions API; job-minutes sampled 6 runs/workflow): PR pytest-run is ~62% of CI job-minutes (502 runs, mean ~36 job-min, ~17.9k min/48h); Guards PR ~2.3k, Guards push ~1.5k, pytest-run push ~1.7k (200 pushes), everything else <1k each. 179 of 233 commits landed on main (77%) touched ONLY research/queue|results, checklist, pipeline, comms, pr-landing/automerge/merge-slot files, yet every one paid the full suite on the PR and again on push (the relevance filter includes those trees because tests read them). FIX 1 (this PR): scripts/ci/pytest_run_scope.py + pytest-run.yml: a data-only diff runs the 155 test files that mention those trees instead of the full suite; non-allowlisted path => full; guards unchanged; check name unchanged. Concurrency-cancel already exists on every PR workflow (3.3k min/48h are partial runs cancelled by newer pushes). NOT changed on purpose: Guards --all on push (post-merge semantic-skew net), push pytest-run for code merges. [2026-10-13 lane CI-DIET] PR1 #17926 MERGED 21:40Z (data-only scope). PR2 (xdist): same tests, -n auto --dist loadfile. Probe runs on branch copies: 14.4 min (first run) vs 33-46 serial; with the two isolation fixes 3 of 3 probe runs green at 11.7/13.0/20.5 min; before the fixes 3 of 3 failed (4 deterministic ml.datasets class-identity failures from tests/test_fetch_backtest_candles_yfinance.py deleting sys.modules without restoring; then 3 MagicMock->Decimal failures from Bybit _LIVE_CACHE/_LOT_CACHE poisoned by mock clients, different files each run). WATCH: any pytest-run failure on a test that passes alone is an isolation bug, fix the test, do not rerun. [2026-10-14 00:15Z lane CI-DIET] RESULT. PR1 #17926 (data-only scope, 21:40Z) + PR2 #17936 (xdist, 23:10Z) merged. Same metric (per-minute concurrent CI-class runs from the Actions API; baseline 24h to 10-13 20:18Z): CI p90 17 -> 8 (23:20-00:10Z, after both; 12 after PR1 only), all-workload p90 23 -> 16 (18 after PR1 only), CI p99 31 -> 11. Window is 50 min, so n is small; the 24h observation (due 10-15) is the proof. Run times: data-only automation PRs 51 -> 7.6-10.7 min; PR #17936 full suite 26 min under load (probes 11.7-20.5) vs 33-52 serial. PROJECTION (not measured): ~12.5k -> ~4.5k CI job-min/day. CAP PROPOSAL (manager to approve, NOT applied): scripts/research/research_compute.yaml github_runner.max_concurrent 3->6 and limits.max_total_inflight 5->8, only if the 24h CI p90 stays <=10 (pool ~20; all-workload p90 16 + 3 extra research = 19 is the ceiling, so do not exceed 6). OPEN: (1) tests/test_research_queue_autonomy.py::test_self_tests_pass fails on queue_replenish self-test, on the automation/research-queue-replenish PRs (full run and both data-mode runs) -> those PRs are stranded, not caused by CI-DIET (the data run correctly caught it); owner research-ops. (2) probe branches lane/ci-diet-xdist-probe{,-b,-c} undeletable from this session (403), prune them. (3) Not changed: Guards --all on push (post-merge skew net), crons (105 scheduled runs/48h, research dispatch not CI).  || [2026-10-15 DUE-ROUTE-20261015] RE-DATED to 2026-10-22; READ: not read this pass: needs the Actions runs API (no workflow-runs read in this lane).
